svg.title: NeuroAssist, Capstone
svg.desc: Brain-tumour MRI to a drafted clinical report. How it works: MRI scan → 3D U-Net → volumes + lobes → RAG report. A 3D Attention U-Net segments the tumour on BraTS 2020 scans, measures volumes and lobe involvement, and a RAG-grounded LLM drafts the structured report. Stack: Python, 3D U-Net, RAG, Flask, PostgreSQL. Programme: Microsoft Elevate × GTU; Data: BraTS 2020 MRI, NIfTI and DICOM.
svg.text: Brain-tumour MRI to a drafted clinical report
